contributions.detail: Form A (page 2) exists and is entirely BLANK - a real zero, not a gap. All three cells of cover line 1 carry the filer's slashed-zero glyph, so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide at 0 and the empty schedule reconciles exactly. Line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate, never itemized) is also nil in all three columns. Per the zero-glyph ruling the slashed glyphs are 0; the verbatim glyph is a slashed zero written as a crossed loop.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 3) exists and is entirely BLANK - a real zero. Cover line 3 reads LAST 933.19, THIS nil, CUMULATIVE nil. The empty schedule equals BOTH the THIS cell and the CUMULATIVE cell (both nil), so the two coincide at 0 and the side is exact against either. FILER ARITHMETIC CONTRADICTION, retained verbatim and NOT corrected: line 3's own printed identity LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE would give 933.19 + 0 = 933.19, but the filer wrote a nil glyph in the line-3 CUMULATIVE cell; on line 4 immediately below he did carry 933.19 into the CUMULATIVE cell. Both cells are transcribed as written.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr form prints no schedule total or page subtotal on either schedule - stated, not invented. Both schedules are blank, so the only gate available is against the cover: p2 rows 0.00 = cover line 1 (nil in all three columns); p3 rows 0.00 = cover line 3 THIS/CUMULATIVE (nil).
gates.row_count: Not run with rowbands.py - zero data rows to count. Both ruled sheets were read at 200 dpi full-page and carry NO filer ink at all; the marks visible on p2 and p3 are MIRROR-IMAGE show-through of the printed statute text from page 4 (heavy on p3, lighter on p2), typeset and reversed, not handwriting. No ghost row was transcribed.
gates.balance_chain: The Carr cover has no beginning-balance line. Taking the CUMULATIVE column as the filer wrote it: 0 (line 1) + 0 (line 2) - 0 (line 3) = 0, but line 4 CUMULATIVE reads 933.19 - it does NOT close, because the filer nil-ed the line-3 CUMULATIVE cell instead of carrying 933.19 forward. Taking the LAST-REPORT column: line 4 = 933.19 = line 3 = 933.19, self-consistent only if the prior report's contributions covered it. This is the filer's own arithmetic and is retained verbatim; it changes nothing about the itemization, which is empty on both sides. CROSS-FILING CHAIN TEST RUN (two filings by this filer in this cycle are in my chunk): chunk key d631eedd (raw/2018/2018_st_Jensen_D_Chad.pdf) is the same filer's 10/30/18 INTERIM report and this is the 12/5/18 SUMMARY. The interim's CUMULATIVE column reads line1 nil, line2 nil, line3 933.19, line4 933.19; this report's TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT column reads line1 nil, line2 nil, line3 933.19, line4 933.19. THE CHAIN CLOSES EXACTLY ON ALL FOUR LINES - not a swapped-cover pair - which also confirms that the nil in THIS report's line-3 CUMULATIVE cell is a filer slip (933.19 should have carried forward, as it did on line 4).
